properties.description:
- Restore strict compilation; implement identity-only nodes, repeated owned component instances, typed properties and atomic validated operations.
- Owner predicates use tracked engine reads; publish changing external inputs as transaction data. Share lazy caches and notify scoped subscribers only.
- Validate existing and new edge requirements against candidate state; test removal/property changes, rollback isolation, missing reads, enumeration and branch cleanup.
- Derive validation/inspection from owned definitions; prove compiler rejection, lazy work counts and safe data rewriting. Review predicate purity: TypeScript alone cannot prove it.
properties.title: Implement the component engine and lazy views
